title: OmniPoser: Flexible Human Motion Recovery in the Wild with Masked Flow Matching
title_zh: OmniPoser：基于掩码流匹配的野外灵活人体运动恢复

paragraphs.en: Recovering 3D human motion from sparse wearable sensors is challenging due to the inherent noise, occlusion, and instability of real-world tracking signals. Existing approaches are restricted to fixed sensor configurations and, when built on diffusion models, are computationally prohibitive for real-time deployment. We propose OmniPoser, a universal framework that recovers full-body SMPL motion from a flexible combination of heterogeneous inputs, such as 3D keypoints, sparse IMU rotations, head-mounted 6-DoF poses, or any subset thereof, within a single model. OmniPoser introduces a cross-modal masking mechanism paired with a Masked Conditioning Encoder, enabling one architecture to incorporate diverse sensor configurations through a masked design. A decoupled dual-stream generative backbone generates complete motion via Conditional Flow Matching, requiring only a single ODE integration step at inference. Across three settings and seven benchmarks, including in-the-wild Nymeria and Ego-Exo4D dataset, OmniPoser performs on par with state-of-the-art methods while running at over 700 FPS. The project page is available at https://jamesbridgewater51.github.io/omniposer-eccv/ .

paragraphs.en: The rapid advancement of AR/VR, immersive gaming, and human-robot interaction has driven a high demand for accurate yet real-time human motion capture. While traditional motion recovery is well-solved in heavily constrained studio environments using dense optical markers, consumer applications require motion capture to operate seamlessly in the wild, relying on limited and imperfect input signals. These intermediate signals can take various forms depending on the hardware ecosystem: 3D keypoints from monocular vision [ 46 , 29 ] , rotations from wearable IMUs [ 26 , 33 ] or smartwatches [ 14 ] , or 6D poses from Head-Mounted Displays (HMDs) and hand-held joysticks [ 38 , 12 ] . Crucially, in real-world scenarios, all these signals are inevitably noisy, fragmented, and unstable. Vision-based 3D keypoints are often corrupted by occlusion and lighting conditions, while rotation readings from sparse sensors may drift by nature or even disconnect due to wireless interference.
paragraphs.zh: AR/VR、沉浸式游戏以及人与机器人交互的快速发展，催生了对既准确又能实时捕捉人类动作的高需求。 尽管在高度受控的演播室环境中，利用密集的光学标记已能很好地解决传统动作恢复问题，但消费级应用要求动作捕捉系统能够在复杂多变的环境中无缝运行，且只能依赖有限且不完整的输入信号。 这些中间信号的形式会因硬件生态系统而异：例如单目视觉获取的三维关键点 [46, 29]、可穿戴惯性测量单元（IMU）[26, 33] 或智能手表 [14] 提供的旋转数据，以及头戴式显示器（HMD）和手持摇杆 [38, 12] 获取的六维姿态。 关键在于，在真实世界中，所有这些信号都不可避免地存在噪声、片段化和不稳定性。 基于视觉的三维关键点常常受到遮挡和光照条件的干扰，而稀疏传感器提供的旋转数据则可能因系统特性产生漂移，甚至因无线干扰而中断。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose OmniPoser, a universal framework that recovers human motion from a flexible combination of noisy and unstable signals. OmniPoser employs a Conditional Flow Matching backbone to enable highly efficient motion generation. In order to support flexible inputs, we introduce a cross-modal masking mechanism that unifies heterogeneous sensor configurations within one model. Zeroing out missing entries, however, destroys the identity of unobserved joints and leads to poor recovery (see ablation in Sec. 4.5 ). We therefore design a Masked Conditioning Encoder (MCE) that replaces each missing joint with a learnable per-joint embedding, allowing the network to reason about which joints are absent and recover them accordingly. At inference, a single Euler integration step maps Gaussian noise onto the motion manifold conditioned on the masked observations, enabling real-time motion recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 OmniPoser——一个通用框架，能够从噪声多且不稳定的信号组合中恢复人类运动。 OmniPoser 采用条件流匹配主干网络，实现了高效的运动生成。 为了支持灵活的输入，我们引入了一种跨模态掩码机制，将异构传感器配置统一到一个模型中。 然而，将缺失项置零会破坏未观测关节的身份特征，并导致恢复效果不佳（参见第 4.5 节的消融研究）。 因此，我们设计了一个掩码条件编码器（MCE），用可学习的每个关节嵌入向量替换缺失的关节，使网络能够判断哪些关节缺失并据此进行恢复。 在推理阶段，单次欧拉积分步骤即可将高斯噪声映射到以掩码观测值为条件的运动流形上，从而实现实时运动恢复。

paragraphs.en: The main contributions of this paper can be summarized as:
paragraphs.zh: 本文的主要贡献可概括为：

paragraphs.en: (1) We propose OmniPoser, a Conditional Flow Matching-based framework for human motion recovery that accepts heterogeneous sparse observations, such as 3D keypoint positions, joint rotations, and their combinations, as input.
paragraphs.zh: （1）我们提出了 OmniPoser，这是一种基于条件流匹配的人类运动恢复框架，能够接受异构稀疏观测数据作为输入，例如三维关键点位置、关节旋转以及它们的组合。

paragraphs.en: (2) We introduce a cross-modal masking mechanism paired with a Masked Conditioning Encoder (MCE) that replaces unobserved joints with learnable per-joint embeddings, enabling the network to distinguish which joints are missing rather than treating all of them identically.
paragraphs.zh: （2）我们引入了一种跨模态掩码机制，并将其与掩码条件编码器（MCE）相结合。该机制将未观测到的关节替换为可学习的每个关节嵌入向量，使网络能够区分哪些关节缺失，而不是将所有缺失的关节视为相同。

paragraphs.en: (3) We demonstrate competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art methods and real-time inference capabilities across diverse configurations and highly challenging in-the-wild datasets.
paragraphs.zh: （3）我们在多种配置和极具挑战性的真实世界数据集上，展现出与当前最先进方法相比具有竞争力的性能，并具备实时推理能力。

paragraphs.en: Our method is closely related to human motion capture with sparse sensors, general human motion recovery, and Flow Matching models for human kinematics.

paragraphs.en: Human Motion Capture with Sparse Sensors . Wearable human motion capture systems offer a portable alternative to constrained optical systems in studios. Existing approaches generally fall into three hardware paradigms: IMU-based systems, head-mounted cameras, and VR devices with sparse sensors. (1) IMU-based Systems: While commercial solutions require dense sensor arrays, recent research successfully reconstructs motion from sparse setups, such as 6 IMUs (e.g., TransPose [ 43 ] , PIP [ 42 ] and PNP [ 42 ] ) or even as few as 4 IMUs (e.g., LIP [ 30 ] ). Under fixed sensor placements, SAIP [ 44 ] incorporates shape-aware motion tracking tailored to real body shape, and GlobalPose [ 41 ] utilizes physics priors to refine global tracking. For a more flexible paradigm, generative frameworks like DiffusionPoser [ 35 ] achieve similar body motion recovery while supporting a flexible combinations of IMU signals. Conversely, to fundamentally counteract inherent integration drift via explicit geometric guidance, inertial-visual fusion [ 26 ] remains essential. Most recently, Stereo-Inertial Poser [ 33 ] has been proposed to utilize a single stereo camera and six IMUs for metric-accurate, shape-aware motion capture. (2) Head-Mounted Cameras (HMC): Reconstructing full-body poses from egocentric vision suffers from severe lower-body self-occlusion. Systems like EgoEgo [ 15 ] and EgoExo [ 19 ] utilize SLAM and hand poses to condition full-body generation. More recently, EgoAllo [ 40 ] utilized allocentric grounding and conditional diffusion to eliminate floating artifacts, while HMD2 [ 6 ] further refined egocentric motion estimation. (3) VR Devices and Sparse Sensors: Inside-out tracking in mixed reality typically uses an HMD and two controllers. Approaches like QuestSim [ 38 ] use reinforcement learning to simulate physics-based full-body avatars from these inputs. AvatarPoser [ 12 ] , EgoPoser [ 11 ] , and MANIKIN [ 10 ] utilize deep kinematics and optimization for highly accurate tracking, occasionally fusing supplementary IMUs [ 3 ] or smartwatches [ 14 ] . Despite these advancements, the majority of these tracking methods remain structurally rigid and tailored to a single, fixed sensor configuration. sents.zh: 基于稀疏传感器的动作捕捉。

sents.en: Wearable human motion capture systems offer a portable alternative to constrained optical systems in studios.
sents.zh: 可穿戴人体动作捕捉系统为工作室中受限的光学系统提供了便携的替代方案。

sents.en: Existing approaches generally fall into three hardware paradigms: IMU-based systems, head-mounted cameras, and VR devices with sparse sensors.
sents.zh: 现有方法通常分为三种硬件范式：基于惯性测量单元（IMU）的系统、头戴式摄像头，以及配备稀疏传感器的虚拟现实设备。

sents.en: (1) IMU-based Systems: While commercial solutions require dense sensor arrays, recent research successfully reconstructs motion from sparse setups, such as 6 IMUs (e.g., TransPose [ 43 ] , PIP [ 42 ] and PNP [ 42 ] ) or even as few as 4 IMUs (e.g., LIP [ 30 ] ).
sents.zh: （1）基于 IMU 的系统：尽管商用解决方案需要密集的传感器阵列，但近期研究已成功通过稀疏配置重建动作，例如使用 6 个 IMU（如 TransPose [43]、PIP [42] 和 PNP [42]），甚至仅用 4 个 IMU（如 LIP [30]）。

sents.en: Under fixed sensor placements, SAIP [ 44 ] incorporates shape-aware motion tracking tailored to real body shape, and GlobalPose [ 41 ] utilizes physics priors to refine global tracking.
sents.zh: 在传感器位置固定的情况下，SAIP [44] 结合了针对真实身体形状的形变感知动作追踪，而 GlobalPose [41] 则利用物理先验来优化全局追踪。

sents.en: For a more flexible paradigm, generative frameworks like DiffusionPoser [ 35 ] achieve similar body motion recovery while supporting a flexible combinations of IMU signals.
sents.zh: 对于更灵活的范式，像 DiffusionPoser [35] 这样的生成框架能够在支持 IMU 信号灵活组合的同时，实现类似的身体动作恢复。

sents.en: Conversely, to fundamentally counteract inherent integration drift via explicit geometric guidance, inertial-visual fusion [ 26 ] remains essential.
sents.zh: 相反，为了通过显式的几何引导从根本上抵消固有的积分漂移，惯性-视觉融合 [26] 仍然至关重要。

sents.en: Most recently, Stereo-Inertial Poser [ 33 ] has been proposed to utilize a single stereo camera and six IMUs for metric-accurate, shape-aware motion capture.
sents.zh: 最近，Stereo-Inertial Poser [33] 被提出，它利用单个立体摄像头和六个 IMU 实现了具有度量精度和形变感知能力的动作捕捉。

sents.en: (2) Head-Mounted Cameras (HMC): Reconstructing full-body poses from egocentric vision suffers from severe lower-body self-occlusion.
sents.zh: （2）头戴式摄像头（HMC）：基于自我中心视角的视觉重建全身姿态时，会面临严重的下半身自遮挡问题。

sents.en: Systems like EgoEgo [ 15 ] and EgoExo [ 19 ] utilize SLAM and hand poses to condition full-body generation.
sents.zh: 像 EgoEgo [15] 和 EgoExo [19] 这样的系统利用 SLAM 和手部姿态来约束全身动作的生成。

sents.en: More recently, EgoAllo [ 40 ] utilized allocentric grounding and conditional diffusion to eliminate floating artifacts, while HMD2 [ 6 ] further refined egocentric motion estimation.
sents.zh: 近期，EgoAllo [40] 利用他心视角基准和条件扩散模型消除了漂浮伪影，而 HMD2 [6] 则进一步优化了自我中心视角的动作估计。

sents.en: (3) VR Devices and Sparse Sensors: Inside-out tracking in mixed reality typically uses an HMD and two controllers.
sents.zh: （3）虚拟现实设备和稀疏传感器：混合现实中的内向外追踪通常使用一个头戴式显示设备（HMD）和两个控制器。

sents.en: Approaches like QuestSim [ 38 ] use reinforcement learning to simulate physics-based full-body avatars from these inputs.
sents.zh: 像 QuestSim [38] 这样的方法利用强化学习，从这些输入中模拟出基于物理的全身虚拟角色。

sents.en: AvatarPoser [ 12 ] , EgoPoser [ 11 ] , and MANIKIN [ 10 ] utilize deep kinematics and optimization for highly accurate tracking, occasionally fusing supplementary IMUs [ 3 ] or smartwatches [ 14 ] .
sents.zh: AvatarPoser [12]、EgoPoser [11] 和 MANIKIN [10] 利用深度运动学和优化技术实现了高精度追踪，偶尔还会融合辅助的 IMU [3] 或智能手表 [14]。

sents.en: Despite these advancements, the majority of these tracking methods remain structurally rigid and tailored to a single, fixed sensor configuration.
sents.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，大多数追踪方法在结构上仍然僵化，并且针对单一固定的传感器配置进行优化。

paragraphs.en: Human Motion Recovery . Human motion recovery from monocular videos typically follows a two-stage pipeline. First, off-the-shelf pose detectors [ 1 , 36 , 39 ] extract spatial keypoints. Second, a sequence modeling network processes these spatiotemporal coordinates to compute 3D motion over time. Early generative approaches like HuMoR [ 29 ] utilized conditional variational autoencoders to optimize motion priors. Recently, Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models [ 8 ] have dominated this field. RoHM [ 46 ] reconstructs globally coherent motions by decomposing the task into global and local diffusion models. It can solves different patterns of keypoints combinations (e.g., upper-body v.s. lower-body), so it serves as our primary baseline. Multi-hypothesis frameworks like CHAMP [ 45 ] and Platypose [ 27 ] robustly handle uncertainty but they also lack topological flexibility. To address in-the-wild complexities, HumanMM [ 47 ] uses multi-shot alignment to ensure global motion continuity across dynamic camera transitions. A recent concurrent work, MoRo [ 28 ] , explores masked modeling to achieve occlusion-robust recovery from monocular inputs. Overall, existing frameworks are insufficiently universal. With focus on monocular images, they heavily rely on the spatial keypoints produced by pose detectors in the first stage. In contrast, our proposed method natively infers human motion from an arbitrary combination of 3D keypoints and sparse IMU rotations.
paragraphs.zh: 人类动作恢复。 通过单目视频进行人类动作恢复通常遵循一个两阶段流程。 首先，现成的姿态检测器 [ 1 , 36 , 39 ] 会提取空间关键点。 其次，一个序列建模网络会处理这些时空坐标，以计算随时间变化的三维动作。 早期的生成方法（如 HuMoR [ 29 ]）利用条件变分自编码器来优化动作先验。 最近，去噪扩散概率模型 [ 8 ] 在这一领域占据主导地位。 RoHM [ 46 ] 通过将任务分解为全局和局部扩散模型，重建出全局连贯的动作。 它能够解决不同模式的关键点组合（例如上半身与下半身），因此被用作我们的主要基线方法。 多假设框架（如 CHAMP [ 45 ] 和 Platypose [ 27 ]）能够稳健地处理不确定性，但它们在拓扑灵活性方面也存在不足。 为了解决真实场景中的复杂性，HumanMM [ 47 ] 采用多帧对齐方法，以确保在动态相机切换过程中全局动作的连续性。 最近的一项同步研究 MoRo [ 28 ] 探索了掩码建模方法，以实现从单目输入中鲁棒地恢复被遮挡的动作。 总体而言，现有框架的通用性仍显不足。 由于专注于单目图像，这些方法严重依赖第一阶段由姿态检测器生成的空间关键点。 相比之下，我们提出的方法能够直接从任意组合的三维关键点和稀疏 IMU 旋转中推断出人类动作。

paragraphs.en: Masked Motion Modeling and Decomposition . Techniques like masked modeling and local-global motion decomposition have been iteratively refined into mature paradigms within the HMR community. Specifically, PromptHMR [ 37 ] leverages spatial and semantic prompts to robustly guide human shape recovery. MEGA [ 4 ] addresses visual ambiguity by formulating mesh recovery as a feature completion task via a masked generative autoencoder. GENMO [ 16 ] unifies generation and estimation by treating variable conditioning signals as explicitly masked inputs alongside a joint local-global motion representation. EgoMDM [ 31 ] embeds local-to-global translation constraints into a diffusion framework to synthesize motion from sparse egocentric sensors. Additionally, PUMA [ 13 ] optimizes the underlying generative training dynamics through progressive unmasking schedules. We embrace these established designs in our work, and adapt them to heterogeneous sparse-observation recovery. We expand the mask from a dropout training schedule into a masked module that unifies different sensor modalities, dictating whether a joint is observed via a 3D position, a rotation, a 6-DoF signal.

paragraphs.en: Recovering 3D human motion from sparse, heterogeneous, and occluded observations remains fundamentally ill-posed. Different sensor modalities (e.g. sparse IMU readings, head-mounted egocentric cameras, monocular RGB detectors, optical trackers, or partial motion capture) provide only a narrow and noisy window into the full-body state. Our key insight is that regardless of sensor modality, all observations can be cast as partial views of the same canonical body representation, and the completion of unobserved degrees of freedom can be formulated as a unified generative conditioning problem. In the following, we first define the unified motion representation ( Sec. 3.1 ). We then introduce the cross-modal masking mechanism and the Masked Conditioning Encoder (MCE) that converts masked observations into a joint-aware conditioning signal ( Sec. 3.2 ). Finally, we present the Conditional Flow Matching formulation, the decoupled generative architecture, and the training objectives ( Sec. 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 从稀疏、异构且存在遮挡的观察数据中恢复三维人体运动，本质上仍是一个病态问题。 不同的传感器模态（例如稀疏的惯性测量单元读数、头戴式第一人称视角摄像头、单目 RGB 检测器、光学跟踪器或部分动作捕捉）仅能提供有限且含噪的视角来了解全身状态。 我们的核心见解是，无论传感器模态如何，所有观察结果都可以被视作同一标准身体表示的部分视图，而对未观察自由度的补全可以表述为一个统一的生成条件问题。 接下来，我们首先定义统一的运动表示（第 3.1 节）。 然后，我们介绍跨模态掩码机制和掩码条件编码器（MCE），它将经过掩码的观察结果转换为感知联合信息的条件信号（第 3.2 节）。 最后，我们提出条件流匹配公式、解耦的生成架构以及训练目标（第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: We represent a motion clip of T T frames as a time series 𝐗 ∈ ℝ T × D \mathbf{X}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times D} , where each row 𝐱 ( t ) ∈ ℝ D \mathbf{x}^{(t)}\in\mathbb{R}^{D} is a concatenation of semantically distinct feature groups , describing a different aspect of the body state at time t t . D D is the sum of each feature group’s dimension. paragraphs.en: To unify heterogeneous sensor inputs within one model, we design a configurable mask scheme that specifies, for a given sensor configuration, which feature groups and which joints are observed. Concretely, a mask scheme defines: (i) a set of visible joint indices 𝒱 ⊆ { 1 , … , J } \mathcal{V}\subseteq\{1,\ldots,J\} controlling per-joint masking for joint-based feature groups (e.g., local positions, per-joint rotations), and (ii) visibility flags for global feature groups (e.g., whether root translation or orientation is observed). Given a mask scheme, we construct a binary feature-level mask 𝐌 ∈ { 0 , 1 } T × D \mathbf{M}\in\{0,1\}^{T\times D} that zeros out unobserved features in the conditioning tensor. However, zero-padding removes the identity of missing joints; therefore, the network cannot distinguish which joints are absent, leading to large reconstruction errors ( Sec. 4.5 ). We address this with the Masked Conditioning Encoder described below.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在单一模型中统一异构传感器输入，我们设计了一种可配置的面具方案，该方案针对给定的传感器配置，指定了哪些特征组和哪些关节会被观测。 具体来说，面具方案定义了：(i) 一组可见的关节索引 𝒱 ⊆ { 1 , … , J } \mathcal{V}\subseteq\{1,\ldots,J\}，用于控制基于关节的特征组（例如局部位置、每个关节的旋转）的逐关节掩码；以及 (ii) 全局特征组的可见性标志（例如是否观测根节点的平移或朝向）。 给定一个面具方案，我们构建一个二值特征级面具 𝐌 ∈ { 0 , 1 } T × D \mathbf{M}\in\{0,1\}^{T\times D}，用于在条件张量中将未观测的特征置零。 然而，零填充会消除缺失关节的身份信息；因此，网络无法区分哪些关节缺失，从而导致较大的重建误差（第 4.5 节）。 我们通过下文描述的“带掩码的条件编码器”来解决这个问题。

paragraphs.en: During training, mask samples are drawn from several configurations. This includes predefined sensor layouts such as VR/AR tracking, HMD with controllers, sparse keypoints from RGB images, and full IMU suits. It also includes data-driven visibility patterns: we estimate per-joint visibility probabilities from the large-scale, in-the-wild Ego-Exo4D dataset [ 5 ] using its COCO [ 20 ] pose annotations predicted by MMPose [ 2 ] . paragraphs.en: A complete human motion can be split into global trajectory and local body pose, however, jointly predicting them from partially observed inputs is challenging because they live in different spaces: global trajectory is low-DoF (degrees of freedom) but must exhibit long-horizon coherence (drift-free), while local body pose is high-DoF but primarily needs to meet biomechanical constraints. To address this, the denoising network v θ v_{\theta} are two streams that are trained independently yet share the same MCE conditioning interface: a global stream that generates the root orientation 𝒓 \boldsymbol{r} and translation 𝝉 \boldsymbol{\tau} , and a local stream that generates body pose 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta} , shape 𝜷 \boldsymbol{\beta} , and foot contact 𝐜 \mathbf{c} . Each stream’s backbone is chosen to match its output characteristics: a convolutional UNet with multi-scale skip connections for the low-dimensional global trajectory, and a Transformer-based Diffusion Transformer (DiT) employing Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) [ 32 ] and cross-attention to 𝐂 ^ \hat{\mathbf{C}} for the high-dimensional local body pose.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的人类动作可以分为全局轨迹和局部身体姿态，然而，从部分观测到的输入中联合预测这两者具有挑战性，因为它们存在于不同的空间：全局轨迹的自由度（DoF）较低，但必须表现出长期一致性（无漂移）；而局部身体姿态的自由度较高，但主要需要满足生物力学约束。 为了解决这个问题，去噪网络 v θ v_{\theta} 由两个独立训练但共享相同 MCE 条件接口的流组成：一个全局流用于生成根方向 𝒓 \boldsymbol{r} 和位移 𝝉 \boldsymbol{\tau}，另一个局部流用于生成身体姿态 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta}、形状 𝜷 \boldsymbol{\beta} 和足部接触点 𝐜 \mathbf{c}。 每个流的骨干网络都根据其输出特性进行选择：对于低维的全局轨迹，采用具有多尺度跳跃连接的卷积 UNet；而对于高维的局部身体姿态，则采用基于 Transformer 的扩散 Transformer（DiT），该模型使用了旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）[32] 以及对 𝐂 ^ \hat{\mathbf{C}} 的交叉注意力机制。

paragraphs.en: For fair comparison, we train two versions of OmniPoser during evaluation: during Ours-S training, mask samples are drawn from the corresponding setting; during Ours-U training, mask samples are drawn from the masking configurations stated in 3.2 , i.e., predefined sensor layouts and real-world observability patterns. Meanwhile, we upgrade RoHM-U’s architecture into RoHM++-U , stacking three setting-specific (namely, Setting 1,2,3) input encoders before the network. paragraphs.en: As introduced previously, this setting is intrinsically under-constrained because the entire lower body is unobserved. Tab. 1 presents results for the upper-body setting. On AMASS, OmniPoser achieves 32.1 mm MPJPE, outperforming both RoHM (34.8 mm) and HuMoR (88.0 mm). HuMoR relies on expensive test-time optimization using a CVAE prior, struggling heavily with complete lower-body absence. RoHM (or RoHM++-U) addresses this using two cascaded conditional diffusion models explicitly trained for this masking pattern. In contrast, Ours-S and Ours-U’s performance are comparable to counterpart models, and surpasses at some of the metrics. We attribute this to the Masked Conditioning Encoder (MCE), which uses learnable embeddings to encode global structural priors for unobserved joints. Furthermore, our model achieves the lowest skating ratio (0.031). This shows that our foot-skating loss (e.g., ℒ skate \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{skate}} ) generates valid foot-ground interactions even for invisible observations, at a fraction of the computational cost ( 1 1 ODE step vs. 100+ diffusion steps). On Nymeria, our model reduces MPJPE by ∼ 64 % {\sim}64\% over RoHM (21.1 vs. 59.3 mm), alongside lower acceleration error, proving our learned priors transfer robustly in the wild.
paragraphs.zh: 如前所述，由于整个下半身未被观察到，这种设置本质上缺乏足够的约束。 表 1 展示了上半身设置下的结果。 在 AMASS 数据集上，OmniPoser 实现了 32.1 mm 的 MPJPE，优于 RoHM（34.8 mm）和 HuMoR（88.0 mm）。 HuMoR 依赖使用 CVAE 先验进行的昂贵测试时优化，在面对下半身完全缺失的情况时表现极差。 RoHM（或 RoHM++-U）通过两个级联的条件扩散模型来解决这一问题，这些模型是专门针对这种掩码模式训练的。 相比之下，Ours-S 和 Ours-U 的性能与对应模型相当，并在某些指标上更优。 我们认为这得益于掩码条件编码器（MCE），它利用可学习的嵌入来表示未观察关节的全局结构先验。 此外，我们的模型实现了最低的滑移率（0.031）。 这表明我们的足部滑移损失（例如，ℒ skate \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{skate}}）即使在无法观察到的情况下也能生成有效的足部与地面交互，且计算成本极低（仅需 1 个 ODE 步，而非超过 100 个扩散步）。 在 Nymeria 数据集上，我们的模型相比 RoHM 将 MPJPE 降低了约 64%（21.1 vs. 59.3 mm），同时加速度误差也更低，证明了我们的学习先验在真实场景中具有稳健的迁移能力。

paragraphs.en: Tab. 3 presents results across three benchmarks. On AMASS, Ours-S achieves 83.2 mm MPJPE, Ours-U achieve 86.2mm MPJPE, ( ∼ 30 % {\sim}30\% improvement over EgoAllo’s 119.7 mm and 50 % 50\% over EgoEgo’s 167.4 mm). EgoEgo couples prediction of global trajectory and local motion, which makes it perform not as well as our decoupled structure. EgoAllo uses special allocentric grounding and conditional diffusion designed purely for head-mounted setups, yielding accurate head alignment (6.2 mm vs. our 17.1 mm). We consider our slightly higher head error a trade-off for OmniPoser’s flexibility. Without hard-coding the head pose, our DiT’s cross-attention propagates the 6-DoF HMD signal globally, allowing our method to outperform those baselines on full-body recovery. On RICH, Ours-S achieves a 25 % 25\% improvement in MPJPE (131.6 mm) compared to specialist methods. Ours-U exhibits a different set of trade-offs compared to RoHM++-U. The lower contact accuracy (0.71) is a shared degradation across all methods due to inherent floor-height ambiguities in RICH unseen during AMASS training. On Nymeria, OmniPoser reduces MPJPE by ∼ 60 % {\sim}60\% over EgoAllo (40.7 vs. 103.0 mm). Its superior contact accuracy (0.94 vs. EgoAllo’s 0.63) highlights that our physics-grounded regularization term ensures stability even for unconstrained ego-centric capture.

paragraphs.en: On the highly dynamic AIST++ dataset, Ours-S / Ours-U achieves the best PA-MPJPE (19.4 mm / 21.4 mm) and MPJPE (26.0 mm / 29.3 mm). Crucially, the Ours-S’s jerk metric (0.29 km/s 3 ) is 5 × 5{\times} lower than SIP and 8 × 8{\times} lower than RobustCap. Unlike RobustCap, which directly regresses visual and inertial cues leading to high-frequency jitter, OmniPoser leverages a decoupled generative architecture. The temporal convolutional UNet smoothly filters the low-frequency global trajectory, which then conditions the DiT to suppress local kinematic jitter, assisted strongly by our velocity and smoothness losses.
paragraphs.zh: 在高度动态的 AIST++ 数据集上，Ours-S / Ours-U 取得了最佳的 PA-MPJPE（19.4 mm / 21.4 mm）和 MPJPE（26.0 mm / 29.3 mm）。 关键的是，Ours-S 的急动度指标（0.29 km/s³）比 SIP 低 5 倍（5×），比 RobustCap 低 8 倍（8×）。 与直接对视觉和惯性线索进行回归从而产生高频抖动的 RobustCap 不同，OmniPoser 采用了一种解耦的生成式架构。 时间卷积 UNet 能够平滑地过滤低频全局轨迹，该轨迹随后为 DiT 提供条件以抑制局部运动学抖动，而我们的速度和平滑度损失对此提供了强有力的辅助。

paragraphs.en: On the TotalCapture benchmark, Ours-S outperforms RobustCap3D in MPJPE (36.2 vs. 42.3 mm), and Ours-U stays competitive with RoHM++-U across metrics. Logically, SIP achieves superior global translation (5.42 vs. 15.9 mm) and hip/shoulder rotation ( 10.6 ∘ 10.6^{\circ} vs. 13.3 ∘ 13.3^{\circ} ) due to the fact that it extracts absolute metric depth from stereo cameras and directly substitutes physical pelvis IMU readings for root orientation. In contrast, OmniPoser strictly generates global trajectory and local rotations from masked observations using general flow matching. The slight performance gap in rigid root translation is a conscious trade-off to preserve a purely modality-agnostic formulation.
paragraphs.zh: 在 TotalCapture 基准测试中，Ours-S 在 MPJPE 指标上优于 RobustCap3D（36.2 毫米 vs. 42.3 毫米），而 Ours-U 在所有指标上均能与 RoHM++-U 保持竞争力。 从逻辑上讲，SIP 实现了更优的全局平移（5.42 毫米 vs. 15.9 毫米）和髋部/肩部旋转（10.6° vs. 13.3°），因为它能从立体相机中提取绝对度量深度，并直接用物理骨盆的 IMU 读数替代根节点方向。 相比之下，OmniPoser 严格通过通用流匹配方法，从掩码观察数据中生成全局轨迹和局部旋转。 刚性根节点平移方面存在的轻微性能差异，是有意做出的权衡，以保留完全无关模态的公式形式。

paragraphs.en: On Nymeria, OmniPoser’s lower MPJPE (16.6 mm) and jerk (0.048 m/s 3 ) reinforce that our cross-modal masking conditioning effectively learns unified kinematic priors, avoiding the need to tune multi-modal sensor fusion heuristics for real-world deployment.

paragraphs.en: Importantly, all qualitative results in this section are produced by Ours-U model 4.2 . In the first row in Fig. 3 , we demonstrate this capability: given a speed-vault clip, one model produces plausible reconstructions under five distinct masking configurations at inference time. Configurations with spatially distributed observations (6 IMUs with keypoints, full IMUs with keypoints) most faithfully track the ground truth, while the head 6d pose setting anchors the head 6-DoF pose and recovers a plausible full-body pose. The upper-body setting, lacking any lower-body supervision, produces a less dynamic but still coherent trajectory. Fig. 3 (Row 2–3) shows faithful recovery on dynamic AIST++ dances and tight alignment on TotalCapture. On 3DPW, OmniPoser produces coherent walking gaits and seated interactions in outdoor scenes, validating that kinematic priors learned from controlled mocap dataset generalize to in-the-wild domains. On Ego-Exo4D, OmniPoser recovers whole-body motion from ego-centric basketball and bicycle-repair activities involving complex body-object interactions, showing our method’s applicability to AR/VR capture scene.

sents.zh: 在实际应用中，用户可以在速度与多样性之间进行权衡（5 步 @ 250 fps，30 步 @ 80 fps）。

paragraphs.en: OmniPoser treats various flexible inputs (e.g. partial keypoints, head-mounted 6-DoF poses, sparse IMUs) as partial views of one shared body model, making it unified for different settings.
paragraphs.zh: OmniPoser 将各种灵活的输入（例如部分关键点、头戴式 6-DoF 姿态、稀疏 IMU）视为共享身体模型的部分视图，从而使其在不同设置下实现统一处理。

paragraphs.en: We achieve this through three components: modular masking with a Masked Conditioning Encoder, a decoupled dual-stream architecture, and Conditional Flow Matching, which altogether allow one model to cover diverse sensor setups while enabling real-time, single-step ODE inference. Across three settings and seven benchmarks, OmniPoser consistently performs on par with state-of-the-art methods while running at over 700 FPS. However, several limitations remain. First, OmniPoser models a single person and does not account for body-object or body-body contact forces; extending the masking abstraction to multi-person interaction or contact-rich object manipulation is an active direction for future work. Second, the cascaded inference pipeline propagates trajectory errors into pose recovery with no built-in correction mechanism; incorporating iterative refinement or feedback between the two streams could further improve robustness, though in practice the single-pass cascade already produces temporally smooth and drift-free trajectories across all evaluated benchmarks. Third, OmniPoser currently operates on the SMPL 22-joint skeleton and does not support hand or face articulation (SMPL-X); the modular feature-group design, however, is readily extensible to finer-grained body models as the corresponding training data becomes available. Extending the masking abstraction to multi-person interaction, contact-rich object manipulation, and articulated hand/face models would adapt our framework to a broader set of embodied tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过三个组件实现了这一点：使用“掩码条件编码器”的模块化掩码、解耦的双流架构以及“条件流匹配”。这些组件共同使得单个模型能够覆盖多种传感器配置，同时支持实时单步 ODE 推理。 在三种设置和七个基准测试中，OmniPoser 的表现始终与当前最先进的方法相当，同时运行帧率超过 700 FPS。 然而，仍然存在一些局限性。 首先，OmniPoser 仅对单个个体进行建模，并未考虑身体与物体或身体之间的接触力；将掩码抽象扩展到多人互动或富含接触的物体操控，是未来研究的活跃方向。 其次，级联推理流程会将轨迹误差传递到姿态恢复过程中，且没有内置的纠错机制；在两个流之间引入迭代优化或反馈机制可能进一步提升鲁棒性，尽管在实际应用中，单通道的级联流程在所有评估基准测试中已能生成时间上平滑且无漂移的轨迹。 第三，OmniPoser 目前基于 SMPL 22 关节骨架运行，不支持手或面部关节（SMPL-X）；不过，其模块化的特征组设计可以轻松地扩展到更精细的身体模型，只要相应的训练数据可用即可。 将掩码抽象扩展到多人互动、富含接触的物体操控以及具有关节的手/面部模型，将使我们的框架能够适应更广泛的具身任务。
